description: A mobile-first finance concept with clean transaction states and quick insights.
content:
## Overview

Finflow is a mobile-first finance concept focused on transaction clarity and quick financial context.

## Challenge

Users need to understand account movement quickly without digging through dense statements or unclear categories.

## Solution

The interface uses clean states, compact summaries, and direct transaction details to support repeated daily use.

## Results

The concept gives financial activity a calmer structure and makes important changes easier to spot.
